messages.text: The selected layout reduces the barrel count from 1,056 to 696 chambers while keeping the endcaps, coils and frame fixed. Clearance checks pass, and the geometric coverage improves. The tradeoff is more barrel size families: 13 instead of 7. I’m generating the updated views and OBJ files and checking native ACTS navigation before publishing.

The native checks passed: all 1,024 zero-field tracks completed and matched the independent chamber-crossing calculation. In the declared barrel direction sample, three-station geometric coverage rises from 56.6% to 69.4%, or 48.3% to 61.8% with the 30 mm border proxy.

The longer chambers still need cuts around the fixed hardware. The field-map smoke test retains 59 masked tracks out of 256, so these results support the layout change without establishing reconstruction performance.

The updated OBJ files and comparison drawings are now on PR #90. A separate validation agent is checking the frozen artifacts, including the chamber counts, crossings and the distinction between angular overlap and physical overlap. I’m updating the PR description to make the new layout and its extra size families clear.

The drawings and inventory now show the remaining hardware cuts and all 13 barrel size families. The widest outer chambers reach a corner radius of 9.0998 m, within the existing field map; the narrow margin inside the native navigation world is documented separately from any mechanical allowance.

The independent check confirmed the totals and found a tradeoff worth highlighting: coverage improves overall, but about 6.1% of the sampled directions lose the three-station crossing they previously had. The new layout gains more directions elsewhere. I’m checking where those losses occur and will include them in the PR response.

The sampled losses are explained by relocated \(z\) seams: some rays now cross the front of one cassette and the back of its neighbour, so they fail the same-cassette criterion. The checks reproduce all published counts and find no chamber overlaps. I’ve added the loss breakdown and examples to the report; I’m finishing the review record and PR reply.

The reply is posted on PR #90 with the updated OBJ downloads, drawings and independent assessment. It includes the 34% barrel-count reduction, the increase to 13 size families, and the local coverage losses alongside the net gain. Local checks pass; GitHub’s build is still pending. I’m closing the project record.

Addressed and pushed to [PR #90, with a reviewer reply](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/90#issuecomment-6288205162).

- Added staggered outer-barrel overlap and longer chambers: **1,056 → 696 barrels**.
- Updated OBJ downloads, drawings and validation.
- Geometric coverage improves **56.6% → 69.4%**, with documented local losses and **13 size families versus 7**.

Local tests and 39 independent artifact checks pass. Coils and field remain unchanged. GitHub’s build is pending; the layout remains a prototype.
